workflows.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  # The release workflow runs this whole file as its gate, so "releasable" has one definition.
  workflow_call:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings

jobs:
  fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check

  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Unit, interop (vs the C library) and golden-vector tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --release

  no_std:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: thumbv7em-none-eabihf
      - name: Build the core for a target without std
        run: cargo build -p zstd-rs --release --target thumbv7em-none-eabihf

  wasm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: cargo build -p zstd-rs-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - name: The module must have no imports
        run: node scripts/check-wasm-imports.mjs target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/zstd_rs_wasm.wasm
      - name: Round trip under V8
        run: node zstd-rs-wasm/js/smoke.mjs target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/zstd_rs_wasm.wasm
      - name: Worker-pool jobs are byte-identical to one instance
        run: node zstd-rs-wasm/js/workers.mjs target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/zstd_rs_wasm.wasm 4

  fuzz-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - run: cargo install cargo-fuzz --locked
      - name: Seed corpora
        run: cargo run --release -p zstd-rs --example fuzz_seeds
      - name: Fuzz each target for 60 s
        working-directory: zstd-rs
        run: |
          for t in decode roundtrip diff_c; do
            cargo +nightly fuzz run -O "$t" -- -max_total_time=60 -max_len=65536 -rss_limit_mb=2048
          done

on: [push, pull_request]

name: CI

jobs:
  tests:
      name: Check
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
        - name: Checkout sources
          uses: actions/checkout@v4

        - name: Install stable toolchain
          uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        - name: Install cargo-hack
          uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
          with:
            tool: cargo-hack
        - run: cargo hack check --feature-powerset --exclude-features rustc-dep-of-std
        - run: cargo hack clippy --feature-powerset --exclude-features rustc-dep-of-std
        - run: cargo hack test --feature-powerset --exclude-features rustc-dep-of-std

  nightly-stuff:
    name: nightly clippy, format and miri tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install nightly toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy, miri

      - run: cargo +nightly fmt --all -- --check
      - run: cargo +nightly clippy --no-default-features -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +nightly clippy -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +nightly miri test ringbuffer
      - run: cargo +nightly miri test short_Writer

limits: Repository/run metadata is a read-only snapshot. Successful upstream CI is distinct from this spike's local evidence and from long-term maintenance.
No upstream security audit, response SLA or Kafka qualification was demonstrated.
